Deficits

The deficits d_k^g(y)=M_k-\operatorname{Re}g(P_k\,y) and the losses \lambda_k=(1+\alpha_k)M_k-M_{k+1} satisfy an exact identity under the perturbation (eq:vdeficit); from it come the backward estimate (eq:vbackward), the insertion estimate (eq:vinsert) and the bound on the losses (eq:loss).

The constant K_n of Lemma K.

def Kc (n : ℕ) : ℝ := Classical.choose (lemmaK n)
lemma one_le_Kc (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ Kc n := (Classical.choose_spec (lemmaK n)).1lemma Kc_spec (n : ℕ) : ∀ r : Polynomial ℝ, r.natDegree ≤ n → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ r.eval t) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, r.eval t ≤ Kc n * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, r.eval s := (Classical.choose_spec (lemmaK n)).2variable (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ)

The deficit d_k^g(y) = M_k - Re g(P_k(y)).

def defc (k : ℕ) (g : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) (y : X) : ℝ := seqM A a k - RCLike.re (g (diag (seqP A a k) y))

The loss λ_k = (1 + α_k) M_k - M_{k+1}.

def lam (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (1 + alpha a k) * seqM A a k - seqM A a (k + 1)
